fusions.name: Kicked Dirt
fusions.desc: Kicks grit through a cone 2.5 tiles ahead for 4 earth damage, with a 30% chance each to leave the target [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone to Ground
fusions.desc: Burrows to a target up to 5 tiles away and deals 28 earth damage that ignores armour, up to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Dig Under
fusions.desc: Burrows and comes up at a point up to 6 tiles away, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Buried Bone
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health covers you for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
